messages:
amy: quick ping — need runtime + infra + security eyes on PR #51420 before we can schedule a merge window tomorrow morning. touching eviction/batching heuristics + KMS cache TTL. specific asks below.

amy: @tariq can you check perf/regressions for live traffic patterns (esp 128-512 seq)? any latency p99 regressions?
amy: @kelly can you validate eviction policy changes against our node pressure tests and confirm there are no unsafe edge cases for pinned memory?
amy: @maria can you review KMS usage (key rotation + audit logs) — PR adds a cached token with 15m TTL and a fallback to instance KMS. security checklist attached in the PR.

amy: quick diff snippet:```yaml
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 256
  pref_batch_delay_ms: 6
eviction:
  lru_threshold: 0.82
  pinned_memory_policy: allow
kms_cache_ttl_seconds: 900
```

amy: timeline: want to merge by 09:00 PT tomorrow to catch the next canary window. if we need more time, say so and we'll push.

ash: (reacts) :eyes:

 t1: (this line intentionally left to reflect brief pause)

 t1: 

tariq: looking now — will run the 128/256/512 seq perf job against canary nodes. i expect one tweak: the pref_batch_delay bump might hurt cold-path tail latency. will report p50/p95/p99 in ~1h.

kelly: I can run node-pressure tests tonight. quick Q: does the pinned_memory_policy change affect our memory accounting export? if yes, we should update the SRE dashboards before canary.

maria: flagged a potential: cached KMS token + fallback means an attacker with limited token access could get longer-than-intended access if rotation isn't enforced. please add an explicit rotate_on_error + forced-refresh cron in the PR or justify why TTL=900 is safe. also add KMS audit-log retention note.

amy: thanks. @maria we'll add rotate_on_error and note retention. @kelly good catch — i'll add a dashboard TODO in the PR and tag SRE.

 devops-bot: deploy-window-check: next available canary slot 09:00 PT tomorrow (2hr window). approved if all approvers sign-off.

 t30: (short pause)

 tariq: perf results: p50 ~ unchanged, p95 +1-2ms for 512 seq, p99 +6ms on cold starts in staging. not ideal but within our SLO for canary. recommend canary rollout with 10% traffic, monitor tail latency for 2h. LGTM for runtime after small comment on code about batch timer drift.

 kelly: node-pressure tests passed on staging-eviction-3. one oddity: when pinned_memory_policy=allow + lru_threshold 0.82, we saw slightly higher swap churn on a node with noisy tenants. I'll own infra canary and throttle the canary to avoid noisy-tenant overlap.

 maria: saw the rotate_on_error commit — quick suggestion: also wire a histogram metric for token refresh failures. otherwise security sign-off pending the audit retention doc link in the PR.

 amy: will add the histogram + retention link now. thanks all.

 tariq: i'll take canary ownership for runtime (will watch p99). @kelly please coordinate the infra throttle; i'll coordinate traffic canary knob.

 kelly: noted — will coordinate and kick off infra staging run at 03:00 PT so we can validate scheduling before the 09:00 canary.

 amy: final checklist for merge: tariq runtime LGTM, kelly infra: will own canary + staging run, maria: pending audit link + histogram (will add). devops-bot confirmed canary slot. unless any blocker in next 2h we'll merge and schedule 09:00 PT canary.

 maria: added retention link and metric in PR. security: +1 after I verify logs during canary.

 amy: great — thanks team. i'll update PR description and set merge target.

 devops-bot: note: please include the canary rollback playbook link in the PR body before merging.

 amy: added rollback playbook. merging is on me once CI finishes and no new comments appear. :white_check_mark:
